title: 1998 AMC 8 Problem 21
statement: A \(4\times 4\times 4\) cubical box contains \(64\) identical small cubes that exactly fill the box. How many of these small cubes touch a side or the bottom of the box?

solutions.text:
The only cubes that do not touch a side or the bottom form the interior core above the bottom layer. This core has dimensions \(2\times 2\times 3,\) so it contains \(12\) cubes.

Thus, \(64-12=52\) cubes touch a side or the bottom.

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: Count the cubes that do not touch a side or the bottom.
